slides.title: 6 things horse owners forget
slides.sub: (until it's too late). How many have caught you out?

slides.title: The flu jab due date
slides.body: Pony Club and competitions check the passport. Out of date can mean no entry.

slides.title: The next farrier visit
slides.body: Six weeks slips to nine without anyone noticing. Book the next one before they leave.

slides.title: Worming or worm count
slides.body: Many vets now suggest a worm count first. Note when the last one was done.

slides.title: The dentist check
slides.body: Most horses need their teeth checked at least once a year. Ask your vet or EDT.

slides.title: The horsebox MOT
slides.body: Easy to forget until the week of the show. Check the date before you plan any trips.

slides.title: The last scoop
slides.body: Sunday night, last scoop of the supplement, shop shut. Keep an eye on what's left.

slides.title: Save this for your next yard visit
slides.question: Which one always catches you out?
